notes.title: Netoria Tactics 2 Is Coming Soon!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622869/95d63afdbc88bb0aef6f81a314f99afde1ebdbb9.png
It's been a year since Netoria Tactics: Revolution Gold launched on Steam, and in just a few months, Netoria Tactics 2 is launching as well! This initial release will be the first 10 levels containing Act 1, the first half of the game. The game will release in early access, with Act 2 to come over the next year or two.

We've still got a couple of updates to push out for Netoria Tactics 1, such as the femboy content mentioned in previous patch notes. So even before Netoria Tactics 2 is ready to release, there is plenty of content headed your way.

Netoria Tactics 2 is a brand new story with the same SRPG gameplay and combat based story decisions as its predecessor. The goal of the game is to take what didn't work in the first game and improve it while keeping what people enjoyed. New features include:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622869/50f2a71f623d8b79a2108536ecb44fb3f409740d.png


 Selectable protagonist. You can play the game from the perspective of any of the four main characters, changing the story, character classes, and levels.
 Improved combat system with equipable character skills and an inventory management system.
 A much bigger budget allowing for more art and better art.
 Engine improvements and quality of life tweaks. 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3575420/Netoria_Tactics_2/
The store page is up, so make sure to go and wishlist and follow the game to be ready to play when it releases! Thanks to everyone who enjoyed Netoria Tactics: Revolution. I hope this sequel proves just as enjoyable.
